scope_note: Derived ONLY from ai-agent-tool repos ['AstrBot', 'ChatGPT-Telegram-Bot', 'LangBot', 'nekro-agent']. Categories are app-type-relative — this checklist does NOT transfer to other app types.

required.aliases: empty response handling / dependency fix / identifier parsing fix
required.day1_tell: Call the dependency-backed parser with an empty HTTP 200 body and identifiers containing dashes/underscores; confirm it returns a controlled empty result and parses identifiers without crashing.

required.aliases: api compatibility fix / provider integration / module import fix
required.day1_tell: Import the module in a clean environment and make one request through the documented provider API; confirm no import errors and the old API shape still works.

required.aliases: environment configuration / default configuration / default configuration update
required.day1_tell: Start with no environment variables or config file; confirm documented defaults are applied and can be overridden by env vars.

required.aliases: localization updates / localization display fix / language localization support
required.day1_tell: Switch UI locale to a newly updated language and open the affected screen; confirm translated labels render correctly without fallback keys.

required.aliases: hot reload fix / plugin reload fix / plugin invocation fix
required.day1_tell: Edit and reload a plugin while the app is running, then invoke it; confirm the new code runs once without stale state or reload errors.

required.aliases: deployment scripting / deployment documentation / deployment manifest update
required.day1_tell: Run the deployment script against a fresh checkout and apply the manifest; confirm the documented deployment reaches healthy status.

required.aliases: request format fix / payload compatibility / payload immutability
required.day1_tell: Send both legacy and new request payload formats, then inspect the original payload object after handling; confirm compatibility and no mutation.

required.aliases: resource cleanup / file handle cleanup / temporary resource cleanup
required.day1_tell: Run the operation 100 times while tracking open file descriptors/temp files; confirm handles and temp resources return to baseline.

required.aliases: streaming persistence optimization / streaming response throttling / streaming invocation support
required.day1_tell: Stream a long response, interrupt midway, then resume/check persistence; confirm chunks are saved correctly and throttling prevents flooding.

required.aliases: file format support / document format support / audio input support
required.day1_tell: Upload one supported file/audio/document format sample; confirm it is accepted, parsed, and represented in the expected internal form.

required.aliases: proxy support / connection shutdown cleanup / proxy dependency support
required.day1_tell: Route traffic through an HTTP proxy, then shut down the client; confirm proxy is used and all connections close cleanly.

required.aliases: adapter integration / adapter configuration / protocol support
required.day1_tell: Configure the adapter with a sample endpoint and send a protocol-level request; confirm it translates and returns the expected response.

required.aliases: action visibility fix / status badge visibility / status indicator fix
required.day1_tell: Trigger an action/status transition that should show a badge or indicator; confirm it is visible in the UI.

required.aliases: permission fix / permission management / command permission hardening
required.day1_tell: Attempt the protected command as an unauthorized user and an authorized user; confirm denial and success respectively.

required.aliases: path traversal prevention / path restriction / path validation
required.day1_tell: Request a file path containing '../' and an absolute path outside the allowed root; confirm both are rejected.

required.aliases: credential normalization / credential autofill / credential configuration
required.day1_tell: Enter credentials with extra spaces/case variation or autofill; confirm they normalize and save in the expected config fields.

required.aliases: default model update / model dependency update / model catalog update
required.day1_tell: Open the model catalog or dependency lock; confirm the new default model/version is present and selected by default.

required.aliases: performance optimization / rendering performance optimization / frontend asset optimization
required.day1_tell: Load the largest expected page/view and record render time and bundle size; confirm they meet the stated optimization target.

required.aliases: configuration persistence / plugin lifecycle cleanup / plugin configuration persistence
required.day1_tell: Change a plugin setting, restart the app, unload/reload the plugin; confirm the setting persists and lifecycle cleanup runs once.

required.aliases: platform compatibility fix / platform integration / capability compatibility fix
required.day1_tell: Run the feature on each supported platform/runtime target; confirm capability detection and integration behave consistently.

required.aliases: sandbox support / sandbox platform adaptation / sandbox feature work
required.day1_tell: Execute the feature inside the sandboxed platform profile; confirm restricted APIs are adapted or gracefully disabled.

required.aliases: path resolution / cached path resolution / path correction
required.day1_tell: Resolve the same relative, symlinked, and cached path twice; confirm the corrected canonical path is returned each time.

required.aliases: lazy dependency loading / dependency loading hardening / deferred dependency loading
required.day1_tell: Start the app without the optional dependency installed and avoid the feature; confirm startup succeeds, then invoking the feature reports a clear dependency error.

required.aliases: log display improvement / log display cleanup / log display optimization
required.day1_tell: Generate multiline/wrapped logs and open the log viewer; confirm entries are readable, deduplicated/cleaned, and performant.

required.aliases: navigation entries / navigation update / navigation links
required.day1_tell: Open the navigation menu/sidebar; confirm the new or updated entry links to the correct route.

required.aliases: context compression / context compression fallback / context persistence
required.day1_tell: Create a conversation exceeding context limits; confirm compression runs, fallback works on failure, and compressed context persists.

required.aliases: search provider integration / web search integration / hybrid search support
required.day1_tell: Issue a query requiring web/search-provider results; confirm provider results are fetched, merged, and cited/returned.

required.aliases: container build fix / container image fix / container image build
required.day1_tell: Build the container image from scratch with no cache; confirm the image builds and starts successfully.

required.aliases: tool invocation fix / method invocation fix / tool request compatibility
required.day1_tell: Invoke the tool/method using both old and new request shapes; confirm parameters map correctly and execution succeeds.

required.aliases: pagination size change / pagination parameter fix / responsive pagination
required.day1_tell: Request paginated data with boundary sizes 1, default, max, and oversized; confirm size parameters are honored or clamped responsively.

required.aliases: metadata description support / metadata display / version metadata display
required.day1_tell: Open an item with description and version metadata; confirm both fields display exactly as stored.

required.aliases: dependency addition / dependency modularization
required.day1_tell: Install from a clean lockfile and import the modularized dependency path; confirm dependency resolution and runtime import succeed.

required.aliases: mode disable toggle / streaming mode toggle / streaming mode fix
required.day1_tell: Toggle streaming mode off and on, then send a request; confirm non-streaming and streaming responses follow the selected mode.

required.aliases: multimodal token counting / document token counting / token calculation fix
required.day1_tell: Submit text, document, and multimodal image inputs; confirm token counts match the model tokenizer expectations.

required.aliases: translation key addition / translation additions / translation correction
required.day1_tell: Open screens containing the added/corrected translations in each locale; confirm the displayed text is localized and not raw keys.

required.aliases: feedback event handling / event state handling / event handling refactor
required.day1_tell: Fire the feedback/event twice rapidly and once after state reset; confirm state transitions are correct and handlers are not duplicated.

required.aliases: preset selection / preset management / configuration preset selector
required.day1_tell: Select a preset, save, reload the page/app; confirm the chosen preset remains active and applies its configuration.

required.aliases: parameter compatibility / parameter type support / test parameter support
required.day1_tell: Call the API/test runner with string, number, boolean, and null parameter variants; confirm supported types are accepted and validated.

required.aliases: invalid parameter removal / invalid command removal / parameter removal
required.day1_tell: Pass the removed parameter/command; confirm it is ignored or rejected with the documented error and no longer appears in help.

required.aliases: argument handling fix / argument handling / argument key handling
required.day1_tell: Invoke the command with missing, duplicate, and renamed argument keys; confirm parsing maps or rejects them correctly.

required.aliases: update progress tracking / plugin update tracking / plugin update detection
required.day1_tell: Install an old plugin version, trigger update check, then update; confirm progress and detection status change accurately.

required.aliases: internationalization support / internationalization enhancement
required.day1_tell: Switch app language/region and load plural/date/number text; confirm i18n formatting and translations apply.

required.aliases: download type handling / file download handling / file download routing
required.day1_tell: Download files with each supported content type and route; confirm correct filename, MIME type, and handler path.

required.aliases: input state preservation / state preservation / input state locking
required.day1_tell: Type input, trigger a state-changing action, then return focus; confirm the input content and locked state are preserved.

required.aliases: ui component addition / ui component simplification / component simplification
required.day1_tell: Render the new/simplified component with minimal and full props; confirm it displays correctly without console errors.

required.aliases: api fallback handling / environment override handling / environment fallback handling
required.day1_tell: Unset the primary API config and set only fallback/env override values; confirm the fallback endpoint/key is used.

required.aliases: compressed image recognition / image compression
required.day1_tell: Upload a large image that requires compression; confirm it is compressed under limit and still recognized correctly.

required.aliases: plugin identifier validation / identifier format validation / identifier validation compatibility
required.day1_tell: Create plugin IDs with valid, invalid, legacy, and edge-case formats; confirm validation accepts only compatible valid IDs.

required.aliases: migration test automation / service configuration migration / configuration auto migration
required.day1_tell: Run automated migration tests from the previous config version; confirm service config is migrated without manual changes.

required.aliases: user access blocking / blocked user handling / user blocking
required.day1_tell: Block a user, then attempt login/API/action as that user; confirm access is denied everywhere.

required.aliases: panel state fix / panel expansion fix
required.day1_tell: Expand/collapse the panel, navigate away, and return; confirm panel state matches expected behavior.

required.aliases: document prompt enhancement / autocomplete prompt enhancement / autocomplete disabling
required.day1_tell: Trigger autocomplete/document prompt with enabled and disabled settings; confirm prompt enhancement appears only when enabled.

required.aliases: task interface / task handling integration
required.day1_tell: Create, update, and complete a task through the task interface; confirm state and integration callbacks fire.

required.aliases: adapter resolution fix / adapter bug fix
required.day1_tell: Resolve an adapter for a known provider and a missing provider; confirm correct adapter selection and clear error.

required.aliases: dynamic model discovery / model discovery support
required.day1_tell: Connect to a provider with dynamically available models; confirm discovered models appear without hardcoding.

required.aliases: configuration template optimization / configuration loading optimization
required.day1_tell: Load a large configuration template and measure startup/load time; confirm optimized loading and identical config output.

required.aliases: recording behavior fix / feedback recording fix
required.day1_tell: Submit feedback with recording enabled/disabled; confirm records are created only in the intended mode.

required.aliases: webhook field passthrough / webhook configuration
required.day1_tell: Send a webhook payload with extra configured fields; confirm fields pass through unchanged to the receiver.

required.aliases: capability indicator display / capability display indicators
required.day1_tell: Open model/provider list with known capabilities; confirm capability indicators match the capability data.

required.aliases: duplicate display fix
required.day1_tell: Load data containing duplicate names/messages; confirm each intended item appears once.

required.aliases: filename sanitization / name sanitization
required.day1_tell: Upload or create a file named '../../bad:name?.txt'; confirm stored filename is sanitized and safe.

required.aliases: fallback request routing / route fallback fix
required.day1_tell: Request an unknown route that should fallback; confirm fallback handler serves the expected page/response.

required.aliases: navigation interface enhancement / navigation view redesign
required.day1_tell: Open the redesigned navigation view on desktop and mobile widths; confirm links remain accessible and correct.

required.aliases: password policy validation / password policy toggle
required.day1_tell: Toggle password policy enforcement and try weak/strong passwords; confirm validation follows the toggle.

required.aliases: quota failure resilience / quota error handling
required.day1_tell: Simulate quota exceeded from the provider; confirm graceful error handling and no retry storm.

required.aliases: model addition optimization / model support addition
required.day1_tell: Add a new model through the supported flow; confirm it appears once with correct defaults and no slowdown.

required.aliases: state reset fix
required.day1_tell: Perform an action, reset state, then repeat; confirm previous state does not leak into the second run.

required.aliases: readiness cleanup handling / configuration cleanup
required.day1_tell: Fail readiness/config validation once, fix config, and restart; confirm cleanup removes stale readiness artifacts.

required.aliases: background command execution / background handler execution
required.day1_tell: Start a long command in background and continue using the app; confirm completion/error is reported asynchronously.

required.aliases: input composition handling / composition input handling
required.day1_tell: Enter text using an IME composition sequence and press Enter mid-composition; confirm it does not submit prematurely.

required.aliases: image size reduction / image management enhancement
required.day1_tell: Upload oversized images in batch; confirm size reduction/management keeps them under configured limits.

required.aliases: message deduplication / stream deduplication
required.day1_tell: Replay a stream with duplicate chunk IDs/content; confirm final message contains each chunk once.

required.aliases: clipboard utility fix / clipboard compatibility fix
required.day1_tell: Copy text using the clipboard utility in supported browsers/platforms; confirm fallback works where native API is unavailable.

required.aliases: filter type support / multi-filter support
required.day1_tell: Apply multiple filter types together; confirm results satisfy all selected filters.

required.aliases: fallback robustness / response robustness
required.day1_tell: Force malformed/partial upstream responses; confirm fallback robustness returns a controlled error or partial result.

required.aliases: response content filtering / response filtering
required.day1_tell: Return a response containing blocked content and allowed content; confirm filtering removes only the disallowed parts.

required.aliases: collapsible settings ui / collapsible interface component
required.day1_tell: Open settings, collapse/expand sections, and reload; confirm collapsible UI works and state is sensible.

required.aliases: scroll event handling / scroll behavior fix
required.day1_tell: Scroll rapidly to top/bottom during content updates; confirm no jumpiness and handlers fire correctly.

required.aliases: configuration synchronization / plugin synchronization
required.day1_tell: Change plugin config on one instance/session and sync; confirm another session receives the same configuration.

required.aliases: empty-state shortcut / empty state action
required.day1_tell: Open an empty state and activate its shortcut/action; confirm it performs the intended first-step action.

required.aliases: json output handling / json parse handling
required.day1_tell: Return valid JSON, invalid JSON, and JSON inside code fences; confirm parser/output handling succeeds or errors clearly.

required.aliases: media handling fix / media delivery fix
required.day1_tell: Send media through the affected delivery path; confirm it arrives with correct metadata and renderability.

required.aliases: timestamp parsing fix
required.day1_tell: Parse timestamps with timezone, no timezone, and invalid formats; confirm correct normalization or validation error.

required.aliases: configuration precedence
required.day1_tell: Set the same option in defaults, config file, env var, and CLI flag; confirm documented precedence wins.

required.aliases: interface refinement / interface interaction simplification
required.day1_tell: Complete the refined interaction flow with keyboard and mouse; confirm fewer steps and no broken controls.

required.aliases: undefined value handling / undefined value fix
required.day1_tell: Pass undefined/null/missing values into the affected path; confirm defaults or validation prevent crashes.

required.aliases: forward message support / message callback support
required.day1_tell: Forward a message and verify callback invocation; confirm forwarded content and callback payload are correct.

required.aliases: usage limitation enforcement / usage policy hardening
required.day1_tell: Exceed a configured usage limit; confirm further usage is blocked and policy error is returned.

required.aliases: emoji support / emoji response handling
required.day1_tell: Send and receive messages containing emoji and skin-tone/ZWJ sequences; confirm they preserve correctly.

required.aliases: threaded messaging / threaded reply fix
required.day1_tell: Reply inside an existing thread; confirm the message attaches to the correct thread and parent.

required.aliases: query telemetry / service telemetry
required.day1_tell: Execute a query and inspect telemetry output; confirm service/query metadata is emitted without sensitive content.

required.aliases: endpoint versioning / versioning support
required.day1_tell: Call v1 and v2 endpoints with version headers/paths; confirm each routes to the correct behavior.

required.aliases: streaming parse recovery / stream parsing robustness
required.day1_tell: Stream malformed JSON chunks followed by valid chunks; confirm parser recovers and continues where possible.

required.aliases: model lookup fix / database lookup fix
required.day1_tell: Lookup an existing and nonexistent model in the database; confirm correct record or not-found behavior.

required.aliases: log level adjustment
required.day1_tell: Trigger the affected log message at debug/info/warn levels; confirm it emits at the adjusted level only.

required.aliases: task cancellation scoping / task cancellation
required.day1_tell: Start two cancellable tasks, cancel one scope; confirm only the scoped task is cancelled.

required.aliases: multi-image handling / self image handling
required.day1_tell: Send multiple images including a self/reference image; confirm all images are associated and processed correctly.

optional.aliases: translation key coverage / translation coverage
optional.day1_tell: Run the i18n missing-key checker for all locales; confirm no missing translation keys for the changed area.

optional.aliases: development database config / database startup config / development configuration
optional.day1_tell: Start the development stack with the provided database config; confirm DB boots and the app connects without manual edits.

optional.aliases: usage count display / usage statistics command / usage statistics dashboard
optional.day1_tell: Generate usage activity, then run the command/open dashboard; confirm counts match the recorded events.

optional.aliases: usage metric correction / usage metric extraction / usage metric handling
optional.day1_tell: Replay a response with known usage metrics; confirm extracted prompt/completion/total values match the fixture.

optional.aliases: websocket messaging / websocket client / websocket delivery fix
optional.day1_tell: Send a websocket message from server to client and disconnect/reconnect; confirm delivery and no duplicate/lost messages.

optional.aliases: configuration key rename / key mapping / configuration key mapping
optional.day1_tell: Load config using the old key name and save it; confirm it maps to the new key and preserves value.

optional.aliases: search algorithm fix / api search fix / search functionality fix
optional.day1_tell: Search for a known indexed item via API/UI; confirm the corrected algorithm returns it in expected ranking.

optional.aliases: code block segmentation / semantic code segmentation
optional.day1_tell: Feed code with functions, comments, and long blocks into segmentation; confirm chunks split on semantic boundaries.

optional.aliases: reasoning display fix / reasoning content fix
optional.day1_tell: Process a response containing reasoning content and final answer; confirm reasoning displays or hides according to policy without corruption.

optional.aliases: command suggestion support / command suggestion feature
optional.day1_tell: Type a command prefix; confirm relevant command suggestions appear and selecting one inserts/runs it.

optional.aliases: qr registration flow / qr configuration flow
optional.day1_tell: Complete registration using a generated QR code; confirm scanned config registers successfully.

optional.aliases: preference state persistence / preference persistence
optional.day1_tell: Change a user preference, reload, and sign back in; confirm preference persists.

optional.aliases: attachment event handling / attachment handling
optional.day1_tell: Attach, remove, and submit a file while listening for events; confirm attachment events match actual state.

optional.aliases: default removal / default behavior removal
optional.day1_tell: Start with no explicit setting for the removed default; confirm the old default behavior no longer occurs.

optional.aliases: encoding error handling / encoding fallback
optional.day1_tell: Load text encoded as UTF-8 and invalid bytes/legacy encoding; confirm fallback avoids crashes and reports replacement.

optional.aliases: syntax highlighting / syntax highlighting change
optional.day1_tell: Render code blocks in several languages; confirm syntax highlighting matches language tags and degrades gracefully.

optional.aliases: display readability styling / code readability styling
optional.day1_tell: Open long code and prose content in light/dark themes; confirm readability styling keeps contrast and wrapping acceptable.

optional.aliases: message truncation guard
optional.day1_tell: Send a message longer than the configured limit; confirm it is truncated or rejected safely with notice.

optional.aliases: migration assertion update / migration existence check
optional.day1_tell: Run migrations when the target migration already exists and when missing; confirm assertions handle both cases correctly.

optional.aliases: ui label correction / display label fix
optional.day1_tell: Open the affected UI label in all relevant states; confirm corrected display text appears.

optional.aliases: oauth service extraction / oauth service integration
optional.day1_tell: Complete OAuth login/refresh using the extracted service; confirm tokens are stored and refreshed correctly.

optional.aliases: model initialization handling / model initialization refactor
optional.day1_tell: Initialize a model with valid, missing, and bad config; confirm clear initialization success/failure states.

optional.aliases: inline mode fix
optional.day1_tell: Use inline mode in the target editor/input; confirm inline suggestions/actions appear at the cursor and commit correctly.

optional.aliases: model option filtering / model filtering support
optional.day1_tell: Apply model filters for capability/provider/status; confirm only matching models remain selectable.

optional.aliases: generated image display
optional.day1_tell: Generate an image and open the result view; confirm image displays with correct dimensions and download link.

optional.aliases: command availability fix
optional.day1_tell: Check command availability before and after enabling its prerequisite; confirm it appears only when usable.

optional.aliases: paired message deletion
optional.day1_tell: Delete one message from a paired user/assistant exchange; confirm its paired counterpart is handled as specified.

optional.aliases: request body cleanup / request body correction
optional.day1_tell: Inspect outgoing request body for the affected call; confirm obsolete/incorrect fields are absent and required fields present.

optional.aliases: model list display / model display fix
optional.day1_tell: Open the model list with long names and metadata; confirm each model displays once with correct labels.

optional.aliases: model parameter propagation / parameter propagation
optional.day1_tell: Set model parameters in UI/config and send a request; confirm outgoing request contains the same parameter values.

optional.aliases: segmentation algorithm fix / text segmentation fix
optional.day1_tell: Segment text containing paragraphs, lists, and very long sentences; confirm boundaries and max lengths are correct.

optional.aliases: response attribute handling / response format handling
optional.day1_tell: Process responses with optional/missing/renamed attributes; confirm response format handling maps them correctly.

optional.aliases: language setting fix
optional.day1_tell: Change language setting, restart, and open localized UI; confirm selected language persists and applies.

optional.aliases: tuple unpacking fix
optional.day1_tell: Run the function with tuples of expected and edge-case lengths; confirm unpacking does not throw unexpectedly.

optional.aliases: localized prompt fix / localized prompt refresh
optional.day1_tell: Switch locale and regenerate the prompt; confirm localized prompt text refreshes immediately.

optional.aliases: text length handling / long text handling
optional.day1_tell: Submit text at, below, and above the length limit; confirm long text is handled without truncation bugs.

optional.aliases: image recognition fix
optional.day1_tell: Upload a known test image and ask for recognition; confirm expected objects/text are detected.

optional.aliases: race condition locking
optional.day1_tell: Run concurrent updates against the shared state 100 times; confirm locking prevents inconsistent results.

optional.aliases: model response fix
optional.day1_tell: Replay a model response fixture with edge-case fields; confirm final parsed response matches expected output.

optional.aliases: event stream abstraction / event stream handling
optional.day1_tell: Subscribe to the event stream and emit start/chunk/end/error events; confirm abstraction delivers ordered events.

optional.aliases: job management / skill management
optional.day1_tell: Create, list, update, and delete a job/skill; confirm lifecycle state is correct.

optional.aliases: dynamic capability management / repository capability management
optional.day1_tell: Add/remove repository capabilities at runtime; confirm capability registry updates without restart.

optional.aliases: resolver improvement / resolver fix
optional.day1_tell: Resolve identifiers with normal, ambiguous, and missing inputs; confirm resolver returns correct target or clear error.

optional.aliases: editor bug fix / editor entry fix
optional.day1_tell: Open editor entry, edit/save/cancel; confirm the bugged editor path now preserves content correctly.

optional.aliases: history filtering / history navigation
optional.day1_tell: Navigate history with filters applied; confirm only matching history entries appear and navigation skips filtered-out items.
